description: Create a link to book a hotel on myservice.pk. The link opens MyService AI with the hotel, dates and party filled in; the user signs in, confirms the live price, enters guest details and pays there. This tool books, holds and charges nothing. Inputs: hotel id from search results, check-in and check-out (YYYY-MM-DD), adults, children's ages, number of rooms, and optionally the chosen room type. Returns `booking_url`.
name: book_on_myservice
